tooltip.fast-noteblocks.invert_scroll: Makes wheel-down raise the selected pitch instead of wheel-up.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.view_distance: Maximum distance at which note labels are shown.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.interaction_dela: Minimum pause after each acknowledged click. Higher values are slower and less likely to upset server rate limits or anti-cheat.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.sequence_enabled: Automatically tunes newly placed note blocks using the repeating sequence below. Can also be toggled with a hotkey.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.sequence: Comma-separated note numbers from 0 to 24. Spaces are ignored; example: 0, 4, 7, 12.
error.fast-noteblocks.sequence: Use comma-separated whole numbers from 0 to 24.
